questions.question: What was Microsoft's total revenue in fiscal 2025?
questions.system_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM income_statements WHERE ticker = 'MSFT' AND fiscal_year = 2025;

questions.question: What was Apple's net income in its most recent quarter?
questions.system_sql:
SELECT net_income
FROM income_statements
WHERE ticker = 'AAPL'
ORDER BY period_end DESC NULLS LAST, fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_quarter DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What were JPMorgan Chase's total assets at the end of fiscal 2025?
questions.system_sql: SELECT total_assets FROM balance_sheets WHERE ticker = 'JPM' AND fiscal_year = 2025 AND fiscal_quarter = 4 ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What was Tesla's closing share price on 30 June 2026?
questions.system_sql: SELECT close FROM daily_prices WHERE ticker = 'TSLA' AND trade_date = DATE '2026-06-30';

questions.question: How much cash did Alphabet hold at the end of its latest reported quarter?
questions.system_sql:
WITH alphabet_ticker AS (
    SELECT ticker
    FROM companies
    WHERE name ILIKE '%alphabet%'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.cash
FROM balance_sheets b
JOIN alphabet_ticker at ON b.ticker = at.ticker
ORDER BY b.period_end DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How much did Coca-Cola pay in dividends per share in calendar 2025?
questions.system_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS total_dividends_per_share_2025
FROM dividends d
JOIN companies c ON c.ticker = d.ticker
WHERE c.name ILIKE '%coca-cola%'
  AND d.ex_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.ex_date <= DATE '2025-12-31';

questions.question: How has Nvidia's quarterly revenue changed over its last 8 quarters?
questions.system_sql: WITH nvda_rev AS (SELECT period_end, revenue FROM income_statements WHERE ticker = 'NVDA' ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 8) SELECT period_end, revenue, revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY period_end) AS qoq_change FROM nvda_rev ORDER BY period_end;

questions.question: What was Apple's gross margin in each quarter of fiscal 2025?
questions.reason: no system column holds the values of gold column 2
questions.system_sql: SELECT fiscal_quarter, period_end, gross_profit, revenue, (gross_profit / revenue) AS gross_margin FROM income_statements WHERE ticker = 'AAPL' AND fiscal_year = 2025 ORDER BY fiscal_quarter;

questions.question: What was Amazon's free cash flow in each fiscal year from 2022 to 2025?
questions.system_sql: SELECT cf.fiscal_year, SUM(cf.free_cash_flow) AS free_cash_flow FROM cash_flows cf WHERE cf.ticker = 'AMZN' AND cf.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 GROUP BY cf.fiscal_year ORDER BY cf.fiscal_year;

questions.question: How did Meta's average monthly closing price move during 2025?
questions.reason: no system column holds the values of gold column 1
questions.system_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', trade_date) AS month, AVG(close) AS avg_monthly_close FROM daily_prices WHERE ticker = 'META' AND trade_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND trade_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

questions.question: What was Microsoft's year-over-year revenue growth in each quarter of fiscal 2026?
questions.system_sql: WITH msft AS (SELECT ticker FROM companies WHERE name ILIKE 'Microsoft%'), curr AS (SELECT i.fiscal_quarter, i.revenue FROM income_statements i JOIN msft m ON i.ticker = m.ticker WHERE i.fiscal_year = 2026), prior AS (SELECT i.fiscal_quarter, i.revenue FROM income_statements i JOIN msft m ON i.ticker = m.ticker WHERE i.fiscal_year = 2025) SELECT c.fiscal_quarter, CASE WHEN p.revenue IS NULL OR p.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round(((c.revenue - p.revenue) / p.revenue) * 100, 2) END AS yoy_revenue_growth_percent FROM curr c LEFT JOIN prior p ON c.fiscal_quarter = p.fiscal_quarter ORDER BY c.fiscal_quarter;

questions.question: How has Walmart's long-term debt changed at each fiscal year end since fiscal 2022?
questions.system_sql:
SELECT
    fiscal_year,
    period_end,
    long_term_debt,
    long_term_debt - LAG(long_term_debt) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS change_from_prior_year
FROM balance_sheets
WHERE ticker = 'WMT'
  AND fiscal_year >= 2022
  AND fiscal_quarter = 4
ORDER BY fiscal_year;

questions.question: Compare Visa's and Mastercard's net income in fiscal 2025.
questions.system_sql: SELECT i.ticker, i.fiscal_year, i.net_income FROM income_statements i WHERE i.ticker IN ('V', 'MA') AND i.fiscal_year = 2025 ORDER BY i.ticker;

questions.question: Which had higher revenue in calendar 2025, Coca-Cola or PepsiCo?
questions.system_sql:
WITH calendar_2025_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        i.ticker,
        SUM(i.revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM income_statements i
    WHERE i.ticker IN ('KO', 'PEP')
      AND i.period_end >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND i.period_end <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY i.ticker
)
SELECT
    ticker,
    total_revenue
FROM calendar_2025_revenue
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Compare the total assets of the Utilities companies at the end of their latest reported quarter.
questions.system_sql:
WITH latest_bs AS (
    SELECT
        b.ticker,
        b.total_assets,
        b.period_end,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.ticker ORDER BY b.period_end DESC, b.fiscal_year DESC, b.fiscal_quarter DESC) AS rn
    FROM balance_sheets b
)
SELECT
    c.ticker,
    c.name,
    lb.total_assets,
    lb.period_end
FROM latest_bs lb
JOIN companies c ON c.ticker = lb.ticker
WHERE c.sector = 'Utilities'
  AND lb.rn = 1
ORDER BY c.ticker;

questions.question: How did Exxon Mobil's and Chevron's operating cash flow compare in fiscal 2025?
questions.system_sql: SELECT c.ticker, SUM(c.operating_cash_flow) AS total_operating_cash_flow FROM cash_flows c WHERE c.ticker IN ('XOM', 'CVX') AND c.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY c.ticker ORDER BY c.ticker;

questions.question: Compare Home Depot's and Nike's net profit margin in fiscal 2025.
questions.reason: no system column holds the values of gold column 2
questions.system_sql:
WITH fy2025 AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    SUM(net_income) AS net_income,
    SUM(revenue) AS revenue,
    SUM(net_income) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) AS net_profit_margin
  FROM income_statements
  WHERE ticker IN ('HD', 'NKE')
    AND fiscal_year = 2025
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT
  ticker,
  net_income,
  revenue,
  net_profit_margin
FROM fy2025
ORDER BY ticker;

questions.question: Which 5 companies had the highest total revenue in fiscal 2025?
questions.system_sql:
SELECT c.ticker, c.name, SUM(i.revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM income_statements i
JOIN companies c ON c.ticker = i.ticker
WHERE i.fiscal_year = 2025
GROUP BY c.ticker, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

questions.question: Which Technology company had the highest net profit margin in fiscal 2025?
questions.reason: no system column holds the values of gold column 2
questions.system_sql:
WITH tech_fy2025 AS (
  SELECT i.ticker,
         SUM(i.revenue) AS total_revenue,
         SUM(i.net_income) AS total_net_income
  FROM income_statements i
  JOIN companies c ON c.ticker = i.ticker
  WHERE c.sector = 'Technology'
    AND i.fiscal_year = 2025
    AND i.revenue IS NOT NULL
    AND i.net_income IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY i.ticker
  HAVING SUM(i.revenue) > 0
)
SELECT t.ticker,
       c.name,
       (t.total_net_income / t.total_revenue) AS net_profit_margin
FROM tech_fy2025 t
JOIN companies c ON c.ticker = t.ticker
ORDER BY net_profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Rank the Healthcare companies by dividends paid per share in calendar 2025.
questions.system_sql:
SELECT c.ticker,
       c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS dividends_per_share_2025,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) DESC) AS dividend_rank
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN dividends d
  ON d.ticker = c.ticker
  AND d.ex_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.ex_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
WHERE c.sector = 'Healthcare'
GROUP BY c.ticker, c.name
ORDER BY dividends_per_share_2025 DESC, c.ticker;

questions.question: Which 3 companies' share prices rose the most from the first to the last trading day of 2025?
questions.system_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT ticker, trade_date, close,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY trade_date ASC) AS rn_asc,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM daily_prices
  WHERE trade_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND trade_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
first_prices AS (
  SELECT ticker, close AS first_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1
),
last_prices AS (
  SELECT ticker, close AS last_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1
)
SELECT c.ticker, c.name, fp.first_close, lp.last_close,
       ((lp.last_close - fp.first_close) / fp.first_close) * 100.0 AS pct_change
FROM first_prices fp
JOIN last_prices lp ON fp.ticker = lp.ticker
JOIN companies c ON c.ticker = fp.ticker
WHERE fp.first_close > 0
ORDER BY pct_change DESC
LIMIT 3;

questions.question: Which sector had the highest combined net income in fiscal 2025?
questions.system_sql: SELECT c.sector, SUM(i.net_income) AS combined_net_income FROM income_statements i JOIN companies c ON i.ticker = c.ticker WHERE i.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY combined_net_income DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What was Apple's price-to-earnings ratio at the end of fiscal 2025, using the closing price on the last trading day of the fiscal year and fiscal 2025 diluted EPS?
questions.reason: no system column holds the values of gold column 1
questions.system_sql:
WITH apple_info AS (
    SELECT ticker, fiscal_year_end_month
    FROM companies
    WHERE ticker = 'AAPL'
),
fiscal_year_end AS (
    SELECT
        ticker,
        (make_date(2025, fiscal_year_end_month, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date AS period_end_date
    FROM apple_info
),
last_trading_day AS (
    SELECT
        dp.ticker,
        dp.trade_date,
        dp.close
    FROM daily_prices dp
    JOIN fiscal_year_end fye ON dp.ticker = fye.ticker
    WHERE dp.trade_date <= fye.period_end_date
    ORDER BY dp.trade_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
fiscal_eps AS (
    SELECT
        inc.ticker,
        inc.eps_diluted
    FROM income_statements inc
    WHERE inc.ticker = 'AAPL'
      AND inc.fiscal_year = 2025
    ORDER BY inc.period_end DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ltd.close / feps.eps_diluted AS price_to_earnings_ratio
FROM last_trading_day ltd
CROSS JOIN fiscal_eps feps;

questions.question: Which companies grew revenue in fiscal 2025 compared with fiscal 2024 but saw their share price fall from the first to the last trading day of 2025?
questions.system_sql:
WITH rev AS (
    SELECT ticker,
           SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN revenue END) AS rev_2024,
           SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN revenue END) AS rev_2025
    FROM income_statements
    WHERE fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY ticker
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN revenue END) > SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN revenue END)
),
price_bounds AS (
    SELECT ticker,
           MIN(trade_date) AS first_date,
           MAX(trade_date) AS last_date
    FROM daily_prices
    WHERE trade_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND trade_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY ticker
),
price_first AS (
    SELECT dp.ticker, dp.close AS first_close
    FROM daily_prices dp
    JOIN price_bounds pb ON dp.ticker = pb.ticker AND dp.trade_date = pb.first_date
),
price_last AS (
    SELECT dp.ticker, dp.close AS last_close
    FROM daily_prices dp
    JOIN price_bounds pb ON dp.ticker = pb.ticker AND dp.trade_date = pb.last_date
),
price_change AS (
    SELECT pf.ticker, pf.first_close, pl.last_close
    FROM price_first pf
    JOIN price_last pl ON pf.ticker = pl.ticker
    WHERE pl.last_close < pf.first_close
)
SELECT r.ticker, c.name
FROM rev r
JOIN price_change pc ON r.ticker = pc.ticker
JOIN companies c ON c.ticker = r.ticker;

questions.question: What was Microsoft's dividend payout ratio in fiscal 2025, as dividends per share divided by diluted EPS?
questions.system_sql:
WITH co AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year_end_month
  FROM companies
  WHERE ticker = 'MSFT'
),
fy AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN fiscal_year_end_month = 12
         THEN DATE '2025-01-01'
         ELSE (DATE '2024-01-01' + fiscal_year_end_month * interval '1 month')::date
    END AS start_date,
    (DATE '2025-01-01' + fiscal_year_end_month * interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date AS end_date
  FROM co
),
div AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS dividends_per_share
  FROM dividends d
  CROSS JOIN fy
  WHERE d.ticker = 'MSFT'
    AND d.ex_date >= fy.start_date
    AND d.ex_date <= fy.end_date
),
eps AS (
  SELECT eps_diluted
  FROM income_statements
  WHERE ticker = 'MSFT'
    AND fiscal_year = 2025
    AND fiscal_quarter IS NULL
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN e.eps_diluted IS NULL OR e.eps_diluted = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE d.dividends_per_share / e.eps_diluted
  END AS dividend_payout_ratio
FROM div d
CROSS JOIN eps e;

FROM companies c
